root_idea.summary: The root centers on excellence, nobility, and the quality of being distinguished, with a parallel development toward oldness, precedence, and release from a former condition.
root_idea.development: From the paired ideas of nobility and age, the lexicon extends to what is choice, excellent, mature, long-established, or freed from subjugation; several specialized usages develop through precedence or emergence from an earlier state.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized adjective citation form عَتِيقٌ.

senses.usage_conditions: In البيت العتيق, an epithet of the Kaaba, associated with its being the first House founded for people and with its antiquity.

An alternative interpretation of البيت العتيق understands the House as protected from submersion, tyrannical domination, foreign seizure, or private ownership; this is a Quran-specific interpretation of the epithet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To precede, outstrip, or get ahead, thereby becoming safe from pursuit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of a horse or mare, and also of one who precedes another thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pass out of a former condition into freedom or a more advanced state.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes a slave becoming free, a girl passing beyond childhood or family service toward marriageability, and a young she-camel becoming free of oral disease and mange.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become thin, fine, or delicate in the outer skin after having been coarse or rough.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person, especially a man, in the cited description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reach the utmost point, extent, or degree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general verbal usage for attaining a limit or extreme.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become sound, good, right, or properly ordered.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a thing, property, or cattle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become old or mature with the passage of time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to clarified butter and wine, where age may also imply improved quality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For an oath to become longstanding and binding.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction describes an oath that has remained in force and is not violated.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bite, especially with the front teeth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is followed by بِفِيهِ when the biting action is specified as being with the mouth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make old by keeping for a long time; to age.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used transitively of a thing and especially of wine that has been stored until old.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a horse or mare hasten, precede, and become safe from pursuit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative counterpart of the Form I usage of a horse or mare getting ahead.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To emancipate a slave; to free someone from slavery.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive causative construction with the slave as object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put property or cattle into a good, sound, or proper condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative construction applied to property or livestock.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To dig and case a well, making it sound or serviceable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction أعتق قليبه, referring to preparing a well with stones or bricks.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take or secure a place for oneself so that it becomes one's property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The place is acquired and possessed by the subject.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put a register or account into an orderly, correct state and take something from it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a personal register or account once it has been made correct and serviceable.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make an oath inexpiable or binding.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized causative usage concerning the legal or binding force of an oath.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Nobility, generosity, excellence, or distinction of quality.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied as a quality of a horse or other excellent thing, and figuratively to nobility or generosity in a person's appearance or character.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Beauty or comeliness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun denoting attractive or distinguished appearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The state or condition of freedom, as opposed to slavery.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used for emancipation and in expressions referring to a freed person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Oldness or age attained by an inanimate thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal expression for antiquity or long standing, especially with inanimate objects such as wine or dates.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A species of tree whose wood is used for Arabian bows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The name alludes to the excellence of the bow made from it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A horse that precedes, outstrips, or outruns others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word may also imply that the horse becomes safe from being overtaken.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Generous, noble, excellent, or choice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to horses, birds of prey, and other things of distinguished quality; with birds, it may denote the noble or choice among them.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A choice or best specimen of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally of a selected or finest example, including such things as a hawk, dates, water, or fat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having reached an utmost degree or extreme.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive descriptive usage that can apply to the highest degree of goodness, beauty, or, in the cited formulation, even their opposites.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A prime or choice substance, especially dates, water, or fat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used substantivally in the cited lexical traditions; the particular substance is supplied by context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Beautiful, comely, generous, or noble in personal appearance or character.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a face, person, or woman; the beauty and nobility senses may overlap in personal description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thin, fine, or delicate in the outer skin after being coarse or rough.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a man in the cited usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Freed or emancipated from slavery.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a male or female freed slave; it also occurs as the epithet عتيق for Abū Bakr, with explanations connected to freedom from the Fire or to beauty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Old, long-standing, or fully matured.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to things including bridges and wine; with wine, it can imply long storage, an unbroken seal, or attained maturity. The Kaaba usage is treated separately under the Quranic form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wine, including the prepared grape beverage known as طِلاء.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantival beverage usage distinct from the adjective meaning old wine.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantival lexical usage recorded without a further restriction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular male palm tree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The tree is characterized by a female palm not shedding its fruit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Well-woven or finely made cloth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a garment or piece of cloth with a good, close weave.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A young bird that has passed beyond the fledgling stage and become independent in flight.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a young bird, including the young of the sandgrouse or pigeon; the usage is associated with having gone forth or outstripped the earlier stage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A girl who has reached the beginning of puberty and young womanhood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited usage concerns a girl who has passed childhood, may be kept behind the family curtain, and has not yet been separated to a husband.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wine-skin whose wine is good or whose odor is pleasant from age; also a wide, good wine-skin or water-bag.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a زِقّ or a leathern vessel, with quality, age, or breadth supplied by the construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An old bow whose color has altered, especially one that has become red or dark.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of a bow aged enough for its color to change.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The upper shoulder region between the shoulder and neck, where the mantle or sword-cord is placed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may be treated as masculine or feminine in the cited usage; its plural is عواتق.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sides, lateral parts, or adjacent portions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural usage of عاتق with the meaning of sides or surrounding areas.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Old wine that has been kept for a long time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-derived adjective applied to wine aged through storage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A kind of perfume or fragrant substance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used substantivally for a particular type of عطر.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man who drives captured camels to safety and outstrips those pursuing them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional intensive expression for one who secures a captured herd while escaping with it.
